C1.question: Who still has to pay?

C1.dialogue: A: How did the professor respond to your thesis proposal? B: Encouragingly, though she urged me to narrow the scope considerably.
C1.question: What did the professor urge?

C1.dialogue: A: Why is the clinic introducing evening appointments? B: To accommodate patients who can't take time off work.
C1.question: Who are the evening appointments for?
acceptable_answers: patients who can't take time off work
people who can't take time off work

C1.dialogue: A: Were the findings consistent with earlier studies? B: Broadly, but the effect was noticeably weaker in older participants.
C1.question: In whom was the effect weaker?

C1.dialogue: A: Is it worth upgrading the office laptops this year? B: I'd hold off, the current ones are still perfectly adequate.
C1.question: What does B advise?

C1.dialogue: A: How did the audience take the director's new production? B: It divided them, some walked out at the interval.
C1.question: What did some audience members do?

C1.dialogue: A: Did the supplier honour the original quote? B: Grudgingly, after we pointed out the clause in the contract.
C1.question: What made the supplier honour the quote?

C1.dialogue: A: How are the apprentices getting on? B: Remarkably well, two have already been offered permanent contracts.
C1.question: How many apprentices have been offered permanent contracts?

C1.dialogue: A: Has the drought affected the harvest? B: Wheat yields are down, but the fruit crop has held up surprisingly well.
C1.question: Which crop held up well?

C1.dialogue: A: What's holding up the planning application? B: An objection from neighbours about the height of the extension.
C1.question: What are the neighbours objecting to?

C1.dialogue: A: Will the library extend its opening hours? B: Only during the exam period, when demand peaks.
C1.question: When will the library extend its hours?

C1.dialogue: A: How did the start-up secure its funding? B: Through a combination of crowdfunding and a modest bank loan.
C1.question: Besides crowdfunding, where did the funding come from?

C1.dialogue: A: Did the volunteers get any recognition? B: The mayor thanked them publicly at the town hall ceremony.
C1.question: Who thanked the volunteers?

C1.dialogue: A: Why did you decline the speaking invitation? B: The fee wouldn't have covered my travel, let alone my time.
C1.question: What wouldn't the fee have covered?

C1.dialogue: A: Has the hospital's new booking system reduced waiting times? B: Marginally, though patients find it far less confusing.
C1.question: How do patients find the new system?

C1.dialogue: A: Did the translation capture the tone of the original? B: Mostly, but the humour got somewhat lost along the way.
C1.question: What got lost in the translation?

C1.dialogue: A: How are the night shifts affecting you? B: I'm coping, though my sleep has become rather erratic.
C1.question: What has become erratic?

C1.dialogue: A: Has the gallery chosen its autumn theme? B: Yes, it'll explore how cities have changed over a century.
C1.question: What will the exhibition explore?
acceptable_answers: how cities have changed over a century

C1.dialogue: A: Did the external review find anything significant? B: Nothing serious, just some inconsistencies in how complaints were recorded.
C1.question: What were the inconsistencies in?

C1.dialogue: A: Are you still thinking of retraining as a teacher? B: Seriously, I've even enrolled on an evening course.
C1.question: What has B enrolled on?

C1.dialogue: A: Why is the bridge repair taking so long? B: Engineers found more corrosion than the initial survey suggested.
C1.question: What did engineers find?
acceptable_answers: more corrosion than the survey suggested

C1.dialogue: A: How did the trial of the four-day week go? B: Productivity held steady and sick days fell noticeably.
C1.question: What fell noticeably?

C1.dialogue: A: Should we accept the first offer on the house? B: I'd hold out, several other buyers have booked viewings.
C1.question: Who has booked viewings?

C1.dialogue: A: Was the documentary as good as the reviews suggested? B: Visually stunning, but the narration was rather heavy-handed.
C1.question: What was B's criticism?

C1.dialogue: A: Did the hotel compensate you for the noise? B: They offered a free night, which I thought was fair.
C1.question: What did the hotel offer?

C1.dialogue: A: Are the lectures open to the public? B: Yes, though seats are first come, first served.
C1.question: How are seats allocated?
acceptable_answers: on a first come first served basis

C1.dialogue: A: Why have visitor numbers at the park dropped? B: Mainly because the car park is closed for resurfacing.
C1.question: Why is the car park closed?

C1.dialogue: A: Did your manager approve the flexible hours? B: In principle, pending a trial period of three months.
C1.question: How long is the trial period?

C1.dialogue: A: How did students cope with the oral exam? B: Well, although nerves got the better of a few.
C1.question: What affected a few students?

C1.dialogue: A: Is the airline's new baggage policy any better? B: It's simpler, but they now charge for every checked bag.
C1.question: What do they now charge for?

C1.dialogue: A: Why did the publisher reject the manuscript? B: Not for its quality, but because the market for memoirs is saturated.
C1.question: Why was the manuscript rejected?
acceptable_answers: the market for memoirs is saturated

C1.dialogue: A: Has the new recycling scheme lowered waste? B: Household waste is down by a third since it launched.
C1.question: By how much is household waste down?

C1.dialogue: A: How did the community react to the proposed tower block? B: With petitions, mostly over the loss of green space.
C1.question: What were people mainly concerned about?

C2.dialogue: A: Did the critics warm to the composer's latest work? B: Grudgingly, most conceded its ambition while lamenting its sheer length.
C2.question: What did critics lament?

C2.dialogue: A: How would you characterise the negotiations so far? B: Cordial on the surface, but neither side has budged on the essentials.
C2.question: Has either side budged on the essentials?

C2.dialogue: A: Is the archive's digitisation project nearing completion? B: Far from it, the fragile manuscripts have proved painstakingly slow to scan.
C2.question: What has been slow to scan?

C2.dialogue: A: Did the evidence vindicate the original hypothesis? B: Only partially, the correlation held, but causation remains elusive.
C2.question: What remains elusive?

C2.dialogue: A: How did the veteran actor handle the hostile interview? B: With disarming candour, which rather wrong-footed the interviewer.
C2.question: How did the actor handle the interview?

C2.dialogue: A: Is the restaurant as good under the new chef? B: Largely, though regulars miss its rustic charm.
C2.question: What do regulars miss?

C2.dialogue: A: Was the expedition deemed a success? B: Scientifically, unequivocally, though the logistical overspend was rather embarrassing.
C2.question: What was embarrassing?

C2.dialogue: A: Is the philosopher's new book accessible to general readers? B: Hardly, it presupposes a familiarity with the field few possess.
C2.question: What does the book presuppose?

C2.dialogue: A: Did the committee's report acknowledge any shortcomings? B: Obliquely, buried in a footnote few will ever read.
C2.question: Where were the shortcomings acknowledged?

C2.dialogue: A: How has tourism changed the old town? B: The bakeries have given way to souvenir shops, much to residents' chagrin.
C2.question: What have the bakeries given way to?

C2.dialogue: A: Was the scholarship board swayed by her application? B: Less by her grades than by the originality of her proposed research.
C2.question: What swayed the board most?
acceptable_answers: the originality of her proposed research

C2.dialogue: A: Did the restoration preserve the building's original features? B: Meticulously, even the hand-painted tiles were salvaged and reinstated.
C2.question: What was salvaged and reinstated?

C2.dialogue: A: Will the new guidelines curb plastic use? B: Only marginally, given how many exemptions were granted.
C2.question: Why will the effect be marginal?

C2.dialogue: A: How did the seasoned negotiator respond to the ultimatum? B: Unflappably, she simply let the deadline pass without comment.
C2.question: What did the negotiator do?
acceptable_answers: let the deadline pass without comment

C2.dialogue: A: Is the symphony's premiere still going ahead? B: It's been deferred indefinitely, the soloist has withdrawn.
C2.question: Why was the premiere deferred?

C2.dialogue: A: Did the study account for seasonal variation? B: Inadequately, which somewhat undermines the robustness of its conclusions.
C2.question: What is undermined?

C2.dialogue: A: Has the firm's founder fully relinquished control? B: Nominally, though she still wields considerable influence behind the scenes.
C2.question: Does the founder still have influence?

C2.dialogue: A: Did the sequel match the first novel? B: Not quite, the prose was as polished, but the plot felt contrived.
C2.question: What felt contrived?

C2.dialogue: A: Is the coastal path still eroding? B: Inexorably, sections have had to be rerouted further inland.
C2.question: Where have sections been rerouted?

C2.dialogue: A: How did the auditors view the accounting irregularities? B: As careless rather than deliberate, which spared the firm serious penalties.
C2.question: How did the auditors view the irregularities?

C2.dialogue: A: Was the guest lecturer as erudite as advertised? B: More so, though her penchant for digressions tested the audience.
C2.question: What tested the audience?

C2.dialogue: A: Has the vineyard weathered the unseasonal frost? B: Remarkably, the older vines proved far hardier than the young ones.
C2.question: Which vines proved hardier?

C2.dialogue: A: How candid was the chief executive's apology? B: Studiously vague, it expressed regret without conceding any actual fault.
C2.question: What did the apology avoid?

C2.dialogue: A: Is the new metro line living up to its promise? B: Ridership has outstripped even the most optimistic projections.
C2.question: Has ridership been higher or lower than projected?

C2.dialogue: A: Was the tasting menu worth the exorbitant price? B: Each course was exquisite, but the portions bordered on the frugal.
C2.question: What bordered on the frugal?

C2.dialogue: A: Why did the mountaineers turn back? B: The forecast deteriorated, and prudence outweighed their ambition for the summit.
C2.question: What deteriorated?

C2.dialogue: A: Has the librarian's reorganisation improved matters? B: Paradoxically, the more logical system has left regular users utterly bewildered.
C2.question: How have regular users been left?

C2.dialogue: A: Did the panel reach a consensus on the funding priorities? B: Ostensibly, but the dissenting voices were merely deferred, not persuaded.
C2.question: Were the dissenting voices persuaded?

C2.dialogue: A: Is the translation faithful to the original? B: Faithful to the letter, perhaps, but not to the spirit.
C2.question: What is the translation not faithful to?

C2.dialogue: A: Did the renovation improve the hall's acoustics? B: Immeasurably, the strings now reach the back of the balcony.
C2.question: Where do the strings now reach?
acceptable_answers: to the back of the balcony

C2.dialogue: A: Was the start-up's collapse foreseeable? B: In hindsight, yes, its growth rested entirely on a single client.
C2.question: What did its growth rest on?

C2.dialogue: A: How does the new head teacher compare with her predecessor? B: Less charismatic, perhaps, but far more methodical in her approach.
C2.question: In what way is the new head teacher better?

C2.dialogue: A: Did the documentary's revelations surprise you? B: Not the facts themselves, but the brazenness with which they were concealed.
C2.question: What surprised B?
acceptable_answers: the brazenness with which they were concealed
how brazenly the facts were hidden

C2.dialogue: A: Is the exhibition's curation coherent? B: Hardly, it lurches from one era to another without discernible logic.
C2.question: Is the curation coherent?

C2.dialogue: A: Has remote working diminished the office's appeal? B: For routine tasks, certainly, but collaboration still gravitates towards face-to-face meetings.
C2.question: What still gravitates towards face-to-face meetings?

C2.dialogue: A: How was the economist's forecast received? B: Sceptically, her track record of overly rosy predictions preceded her.
C2.question: Why was the forecast received sceptically?
acceptable_answers: her track record of overly rosy predictions

C2.dialogue: A: Did the festival organisers address the overcrowding? B: Belatedly, after the second night had already descended into chaos.
C2.question: Which night descended into chaos?

C2.dialogue: A: Is the architect's design as audacious as rumoured? B: Even more so, the cantilevered roof seems almost to defy gravity.
C2.question: What seems to defy gravity?

C2.dialogue: A: Did the mediation resolve the neighbours' dispute? B: It tempered the hostility, though the underlying grievance remains unaddressed.
C2.question: What remains unaddressed?

C2.dialogue: A: How did the chess prodigy fare in the final round? B: She salvaged a draw from a position most deemed hopeless.
C2.question: What was the result?

C2.dialogue: A: Was the museum's acquisition of the painting controversial? B: Mildly, given that its provenance had never been fully established.
C2.question: What had never been fully established?

C2.dialogue: A: Did the cookbook live up to the chef's reputation? B: Inspired recipes, though many ingredients are virtually unobtainable.
C2.question: What is the problem with many ingredients?

C2.dialogue: A: Has the company's rebranding resonated with younger customers? B: Not noticeably, if anything it has alienated its loyal older clientele.
C2.question: Whom has the rebranding alienated?
